title: Cute idea, don’t hold a shape
text:
Cute idea, don’t hold a shape. I wanted to love these, though I wasn’t expecting to get them in the red, so they don’t really fit my decor. Beyond that, they do not hold a shape/flat bottom, even when filled. I’m currently trying to weigh them down with books inside in the hope that I can reshape them. Many of this style of “box” organizer have a flat cardboard insert to help it keep its shape, these did not come with that so each one just maintains its own unique wonky shape.

I do think that the white & gray style looks cute but these aren’t super functional for me as they tip over easily. I’m going to be trying these in my closet to hold shoes and belts and scarves. If they don’t work for that, I’m not sure what to do with them.
